name: Carlos González
bio: Carlos González Fernández (born 24 May 1997) is a Spanish actor. Gonzalez studied acting at Estudio Corazza para la Actuación, the same school as fellow countryman Javier Bardem. Gonzalez had been acting in plays and shows, but hadn't made a debut in films until La Bola Negra (2026), playing Alberto. Gonzalez identifies as non-binary, and prefers both feminine and masculine pronouns.

credits.title: La Bola Negra
credits.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

credits.title: Doll
credits.overview: This story takes place in the suburbs, at night in Madrid. Tomás, our protagonist, is a young 21-year-old actor who asks for a cab back home after going out partying. He is picked up by a driver, and what seems to start as a normal conversation between client and cab driver, begins to take a nuance out of the ordinary.
